faqs.title: Straight answers about Connection Pilot.
faqs.description: Learn how Connection Pilot helps small businesses organize customer communications, schedules, and customer service.

questions.question: What is Connection Pilot?
questions.answer: Connection Pilot is a connected business workspace for managing customers, appointments, messages, and AI-supported business operations.

questions.question: What does Pilot do?
questions.answer: Pilot is your AI business assistant. It helps surface important customer and appointment context, answers questions about workspace records, and supports clear follow-up.

questions.question: Is the AI Voice Receptionist available?
questions.answer: Not yet. The AI Voice Receptionist is coming soon and will not answer or route calls until the feature is released.

questions.question: Will my team still have control?
questions.answer: Yes. Your team controls the business information and booking rules the assistant follows. Record updates happen only when you explicitly request an available action.

questions.question: Can I manage appointments and customer history?
questions.answer: Yes. Connection Pilot keeps customer profiles, activities, conversations, notes, and appointments connected in the same workspace.
